Context: 8. Entitlement for family on death of a Subscriber

On death of a subscriber, action will be taken by the Head of Office for disbursement of benefits in accordance with the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 1972. If the death is attributable to Government service, further action will be taken by the Head of Office for disbursement of benefits in accordance with Extraordinary Pension Rules.
